offer.text: Night caught me out and my heart's at home worrying. Guard me and I'll lead us to my beloved — I just want to be at their side before the dark deepens.

accept.text: Thank you. Keep close and I'll find the way to them.

decline.text: Then I'll hurry on alone and hope love is enough to keep me safe.

in_progress.text: Almost to them now — don't let anything stop us.

ready.text: There they are! Oh, thank you.

complete.text: Reunited, and all because you walked the dark with me. Bless you.

failed.text: We were parted by the dark... I made it, but only just. Another night.
